name: @red-cup-engineering/durante
description: durante — a QUAKE-like first-person shooter on @red-cup-engineering/abrash (a software-3D pixel engine). You walk a level, strafe, and shoot a demon. The paraconsistent TWIST rides the substrate three ways: (1) THE ARENA IS A MERGE OF TRACES — the level settles from the federated union of every player's trace, and a wall two traces disagree about is a CONTESTED phase gate you can walk through. (2) A WEAPON'S EFFECT IS EVIDENCE — a shot appends deny(demon,'alive') to the trace rather than subtracting a hit-point. (3) THE ENEMY IS HELD ⊤ — between your first wound and the kill, a demon is alive-AND-dead, a held contradiction, until enough deny-evidence SETTLES it to dead. Browser-playable: a <canvas> face driven by requestAnimationFrame, keyboard-complete controls (arrows/WASD move+turn, space fires — no mouse required), served by a zero-dependency Node HTTP server.

scripts.check: for f in src/*.mjs web/*.mjs scripts/*.mjs agents/*.mjs; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
